# Gateway readiness scorecard, agent placed card orders

> When an AI agent places a card order through a gateway, what does the merchant get back that says so, and does that signal reach the dispute? 25 gateways, 7 cells each, every cell read from the vendor's own public docs and linked to its source page. Kept by Nick Kaufman. The data and the code are open under Apache-2.0.

Card orders only, read from public docs. A field a vendor has not documented will not show here. Vendor pages change. Open the source link before you lean on a cell.

## Cell codes

- YES: documented, field or sentence quoted
- PART: documented in part
- NO: doc says it does not
- SILENT: relevant doc read, nothing on it
- ASK: no relevant doc found or reachable
- ANN: announced only, no live product or doc

## Data

- [The card](https://flyingmiata-droid.github.io/agent-order-record/): all 25 gateways in one table
- [scorecard.json](https://flyingmiata-droid.github.io/agent-order-record/data/scorecard.json): the same data with reading notes and source links

## Gateways

- [Stripe](https://flyingmiata-droid.github.io/agent-order-record/gateways/stripe/): Accepts agent orders YES; Agent field in API YES; Shows in reporting YES; Reaches disputes SILENT; Risk rules read it YES; Token scoped to merchant YES; Refund guidance YES
